camera.position: Prop the iPhone upright at face height, about an arm's length away, front camera facing you with face and jaw visible.

title: Smiling, Yawning and Expressions
summary: Make everyday facial movements without eating.
purpose: Collect mouth and jaw movements unrelated to eating as hard negatives for both the video labeller and the motion detector.

request.summary: Smiling, yawning and mouth movements can look like chewing to video and motion.

preparation: Wear both AirPods and confirm they are connected to this iPhone.
Prop the iPhone so your face and jaw are visible.
Use steady, even lighting on your face.
Stay within the camera view for the whole recording.
Do not eat, drink or chew gum during this recording.

activities.instruction: Look at the camera and nod distinctly
activities.expected_behavior: One clear nod visible in video and AirPods motion; mouth still

activities.instruction: Smile and relax a few times
Yawn or open your mouth wide a few times
Purse and press your lips, then relax
Sit still with your mouth relaxed

activities.expected_behavior: One clear nod visible in video and AirPods motion; mouth still
